# Certified referral results (test split, repeated halves)

delta = 0.1; 500 calibration/test splits per run; violation = seed-averaged fraction of splits whose realized test-half selective risk > alpha; it includes test-half sampling noise, so it can exceed delta even when the population risk is controlled; pop_violation = fraction of splits whose selective risk on the whole test set (the finite population the calibration half is drawn from) exceeds alpha.
